dct_description_sm: Since 2012, this case has been played 1024 times.

A virtual board game where students get to explore different types of careers. Based on the original board game Careers. Produced for the TIDE Project about Early Brain and Biological Development, the effect of addictions. This game was intended to illustrate process addictions eg. gaming, internet, gambling etc.
dct_title_s: Medical Careers - a virtual board game
